subject: Mutual action plan and acceptance timeline for Cardinal Therapeutics
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@cardinaltx.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.reed@cardinaltx.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + acceptance windows — timeline proposal

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Leadership is aligned and procurement wants a short, clear mutual action plan (MAP) so we can track evidence delivery alongside legal signoff. High level asks from our side:

- A proposed week-by-week timeline for the pilot acceptance (functional and security checks)
- A list of artifacts Redwood will provide for SOC2/data handling evidence and an owner for each
- Expected turnaround for your DPA redlines so our legal team can slot reviews

Can you send a MAP we can review with our procurement and legal teams? We have an internal signature window the week of Oct 18 if everything looks good — but the faster we lock dependencies the more likely we hit that date.

Also attaching the procurement checklist procurement asked us to fill in.

Thanks,
Elena Morales\Director of IT Procurement\Cardinal Therapeutics
[Attachment: procurement_checklist_cardinal.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@cardinaltx.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + acceptance windows — timeline proposal

Elena — thanks for the clear asks. Attaching a first-pass MAP that breaks the pilot and legal path into weeks and calls out artifact owners. Key points up front:

- We propose a 5-week pilot acceptance window starting Oct 4 with a target signature/PO the week of Oct 18 if evidence and DPA are green.
- Redwood will deliver: SOC2 summary excerpt, data handling runbook, KV cache retention doc, live demo checklist, and a short performance baseline for the representative dataset you shared.
- Legal: we can turnaround DPA redline initial pass within 3 business days of receiving your preferred template; final negotiation typically 2–3 rounds over ~7–10 business days depending on overlap with your counsel.

I've assigned owners in the MAP workbook: Jordan owns evidence packaging and the performance baseline; Karthik will lead DPA coordination and redline consolidation.

Attachments: Cardinal_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with week-by-week tasks), evidence_snapshot.pdf (what we typically provide).

Action requested: please confirm if Oct 4 start is acceptable and share any hard constraints on your legal team's availability for the two-week review window. If you prefer an earlier start we can compress some activities but that increases dependency risk.

Best,
Jonas Weber\Enterprise Sales Lead — Redwood Inference\jonas_weber@redwood.ai
[Attachment: Cardinal_MAP_v1.xlsx (excel, 48KB)]
[Attachment: evidence_snapshot.pdf (pdf, 220KB)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@cardinaltx.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + acceptance windows — timeline proposal

Elena — looping in legal on the Redwood side. Quick notes on process and a couple of asks to keep timeline realistic:

1) Please send the Cardinal standard DPA (or your markups) today if possible. I will do an initial redline pass within 72 hours and call out any nonstandard requirements that typically add negotiation time (data residency escrow, SLA carve-outs, indemnity caps).

2) For acceptance evidence: if you can confirm which subset of the MAP artifacts are required for an initial acceptance (vs. final), we can prioritize packaging. Typical split we see: security/evidence bundle for go/no-go on pilot (week 2) and full operational artifacts for final acceptance (week 5).

3) If procurement needs a signed letter of intent to hold the Oct 18 window we can produce a short LOI that commits both parties to the MAP cadence and the order form timeline while Nego continues. Let me know.

I'll attach my initial DPA redline once I receive your template — small heads-up: we will propose a pragmatic SLA fallback (model variant fallback + transient capacity window) rather than a hard outage credit approach; that usually keeps cycles short.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer\Director, Legal Ops — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]

Elena — quick practical note from ops: to hit the Oct 4 pilot start we need these three items delivered from Cardinal by Sep 29 at the latest:

- Final test dataset snapshot (anonymized) for performance validation\- Contact for your security reviewer (name + available times)\- Confirmation whether you require on-prem or VPC private deployment for the pilot (affects provisioning lead time)

If one or two of those lag into the first week of Oct we can still start but will shift some acceptance checks to asynchronous evidence collection. If your team prefers, Jonas and I can do a 30-minute alignment call on Sep 28 to triage blockers.

-Jordan Blake\Customer Solutions\Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — this is helpful and on-point. Quick replies to the asks:

- DPA: attaching our standard DPA. Tom Reed (copied) will own the legal thread on our side.
- Test dataset: we'll deliver an anonymized snapshot by EOD Sep 29 (file share link coming).
- Security reviewer: Leah Park (leah.park@cardinaltx.com), can do 30-min slots Sep 30–Oct 1 (mornings).

We reviewed the MAP and the Oct 4 start is acceptable provided the DPA redline is shared quickly. We would welcome an LOI to hold Oct 18 while final diligence and commercial terms conclude.
